_about: Learned live on bestbuy.com search pages on 2026-10-29 (scratch/bestbuy/probe_search.py, probe_cards.py, probe_input.py). Cards carry data-product-id (the SKU) and data-testid hooks - Best Buy's own stable attributes, not generated classes.

search_box.name: What can we help you find? Suggestions appear below
search_box.description: Header search field - a TEXTAREA (placeholder 'Search Best Buy'). Sticky header: stays at the top while scrolling.

search_submit.name: Submit search
search_submit.description: Header search button (data-testid SearchButton-TestID). Clicked with a trusted CDP click after typing.
search_submit.notes: #autocomplete-clear-button ('Clear') sits right before it - never take the first button near the box

result_card.description: One search result; data-product-id is the SKU. Cards render their content only when scrolled into view (empty innerText before).

card_link.description: Product link; its text is the full title. URL /product/<slug>/<id>.

card_price.description: Price to pay ('$472.99' followed by the split dollars/cents '$47299' - take the first $X.XX).

card_comp_value.description: 'Comp. Value: $479.99' - a reference value, NEVER the price.

card_shipping.description: Shipping message for the user's store/location ('Shipping unavailable', or a delivery promise).

card_pickup.description: Store pickup message ('Pickup unavailable' / pickup today at <store>).

card_unavailable.description: Disabled 'Unavailable' button: the product can't be bought at all.

store_name.description: The header shows 'Your store <name>' - availability messages are for this store/location. Read only; never changed.
